verdict_reason: Divider removal matches the ticket tech note and is covered by fit tests for the three converted fields, but the shared countryItems also feeds the still-plain transhipmentDestinationCountry select, which loses its divider and contradicts the new comment.

todos.fix: Either convert transhipmentDestinationCountry to appAccessibleAutocomplete too (matches the story's 'wherever the journey asks for a country', add a fit test), or keep a divider-bearing list for that one select; then make the comment match what the lists actually feed.
